meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装好后会在本机 127.0.0.1 起一个只读网页仪表盘,指向能以 JSON 列出资源的 CLI(如 ncl、docker)后,按资源自动生成标签页和表格,无需改代码。预接 NanoClaw 的 ncl,另有消息活跃度图表、日志尾部、只读文件查看器。
howto.when: 当你要求安装 clidash 只读仪表盘,或想让 ncl、docker 等 CLI 能列出的资源在浏览器中查看时,这个技能会接管。

say.text: 帮我把 add-clidash 装上,在 tools/clidash 里启动
say.note: 复制工具目录并给出运行命令

say.text: 怎么在 clidash 配置里再加一个 docker CLI?
say.note: 说明加 CLI 只改配置即可

say.text: clidash 启动报找不到配置,怎么排查?
say.note: 按 ENOENT 排查步骤处理

howto.what_en: Installs clidash: a read-only web dashboard bound to 127.0.0.1. Point it at a CLI that lists resources as JSON (ncl, docker) and it builds tabs and tables at runtime. Pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl, with activity charts, logs, and a file viewer.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to install the clidash read-only dashboard, or want resources listed by ncl, docker, and similar CLIs viewable in a browser.

say_en.text: Install the add-clidash skill and run it from tools/clidash
say_en.note: Copies the tool dir in and gives run commands

say_en.text: How do I add docker as a second CLI in clidash's config?
clidash won't start — config not found. How do I fix it?
say_en.note: Walks through the ENOENT troubleshooting steps
